The Gate independently reconstructs the deterministic context identity and exactly matches every OCI receipt hash, size, count and source-manifest digest. Release readiness and cutover fail while any active write-in-flight, write-uncertain or readback-mismatch Case uses a policy or provider projection that the candidate image cannot recover; compatible recovery must drain those Cases before the candidate becomes ready.

requirements.business_risk: A release is declared locally acceptable after running only convenient checks or omitting product, architecture or evidence review
requirements.design_control: The Gate executes from a digest-named immutable snapshot and verifies source, inputs and mutation journals before, between and after every step. The required deterministic suite set and order are fixed, and nonzero exit, collection error, timeout, overflow, skip or zero tests fail closed. Canonical external control clauses exactly define all traceability claims and cannot be deleted or rewritten together with an implementation-authored summary. The review universe is derived bottom-up from accepted release, runtime, deployment, migration, review tooling and fixed-baseline worktree state including additions and deletions. Each atomic claim is partitioned into bounded semantic shards whose union covers every required vertex and dependency edge without omission. Every review shard runs in a distinct fixed read-only approved Codex process whose executable, prompt, nonce and execution identity are replayable. Every actual-content chunk is nonce, path, offset, size and hash bound and must be complete, ordered, untruncated and within encoded-output capacity. Every probe obligation runs a fixed in-memory implementation mutation after a green baseline and must fail the specified collected assertion with zero skip or collection error. Every cited positive and adversarial executable test is rerun by the Gate from current bytes with zero skip. Each structured reviewer verdict reports all mandated review axes, concrete evidence, adversarial checks, rationale and residual risk; prose placeholders cannot close. The aggregator requires the exact expected set of requirement, claim, shard and probe-obligation artifacts under one source, subject, universe, graph and partition identity. Current local-Agent raw events and final output mechanically bind target choreography, writes, receipts, exact readback and source-truth boundaries. Crash evidence uses real independent processes and current generator and source fingerprints at each governed crash boundary. Redacted raw command, output, final, invocation and artifact bytes are individually hashed and any byte change invalidates closure. The local Gate cannot self-close Gate L or substitute its own evidence for independent external approval.
